title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：pagoda　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pagoda 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the warden ① built the pagoda that no resident in the centre would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the month. The ② pagoda, meaning the tower itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a pagoda, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ pagoda in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ pagoda at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pagoda, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the warden said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pagoda was the whole of the matter, meaning the faith and not the tower. The ⑥ pagoda, meaning the faith and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pagoda, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a tower and a faith. He said the faith is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ pagoda had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ pagoda of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of recording; pagoda, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pagoda I remember is the tower recorded in the register, which closed in 1985 and is still recorded as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ pagoda, my mother said in 1987, is the only tower that improves by being recorded; every pagoda, she said, is a faith that has agreed to look like a tower. She said the faith was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 塔；宝塔（指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 塔；宝塔（指那座塔本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the pagoda 建这一座塔
D. n. 塔；宝塔（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 塔之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的塔之事）
F. n. 塔；宝塔（指登记册里写到、被记载的那一座）
G. n. 塔、信仰（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信仰（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the pagoda that no resident in the centre would have recorded
The pagoda, meaning the tower itself and not the notice
the pagoda at the far gate
the pagoda was the whole of the matter
the pagoda had become a line in a register
The pagoda of the whole thing
A pagoda, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: build the pagoda 意为“建这一座塔”，1978 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记载的一座塔做了一遍。
pagoda 意为“塔；宝塔”，指那座塔本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
pagoda 意为“塔；宝塔”，指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
pagoda 意为“塔；宝塔”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pagoda 意为“塔、信仰”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座信仰就是那件事的全部。
pagoda 意为“信仰”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座塔，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pagoda 意为“塔；宝塔”，指登记册里写到、被记载的那一座，到 1983 年这一座成了登记册里的一行。
pagoda 意为“塔之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的塔之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记载。
pagoda 意为“塔；宝塔”，我记得的是登记册里记载过的那一座，1985 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一座。
pagoda 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，塔是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的塔。
